functions.briefEn: Enable ExtiLine Interrupt request for Lines in range 0 to 31
functions.briefZh: 使能 EXTI 0~31 线中指定线的中断请求。
remarks: The reset value for the direct or internal lines (see RM) is set to 1 in order to enable the interrupt by default. Bits are set automatically at Power on.

functions.name: LL_EXTI_EnableRisingTrig_0_31

params.name: ExtiLine
params.descEn: This parameter can be a combination of the following values:
params.descZh: EXTI 线号，取 LL_EXTI_LINE_0 等。

functions.briefEn: Enable ExtiLine Rising Edge Trigger for Lines in range 0 to 31
functions.briefZh: 使能 EXTI 指定线的上升沿触发。
remarks: The configurable wakeup lines are edge-triggered. No glitch must be generated on these lines. If a rising edge on a configurable interrupt line occurs during a write operation in the EXTI_RTSR register, the pending bit is not set. Rising and falling edge triggers can be set for the same interrupt line. In this case, both generate a trigger condition.
Please check each device line mapping for EXTI Line availability

functions.briefEn: Generate a software Interrupt Event for Lines in range 0 to 31
functions.briefZh: 软件触发 EXTI 指定线，模拟一次硬件边沿。
remarks: If the interrupt is enabled on this line in the EXTI_IMR, writing a 1 to this bit when it is at '0' sets the corresponding pending bit in EXTI_PR resulting in an interrupt request generation. This bit is cleared by clearing the corresponding bit in the EXTI_PR register (by writing a 1 into the bit)
Please check each device line mapping for EXTI Line availability
